outlierDecisions.decision: Retain the clear 16.4 ft White Post Lane dot. The map places it east of the railway beside the chemical works; the large held-out prediction draws on sparse surrounding controls across strong local relief. Do not raise the observed lane to a neighbouring average.

Retain the clear 42.5 ft park-path dot beside St Augustine’s church. It is distinct from the church building and lower 39.6 ft church-ground dot. Reconcile the local park-edge slope when joining terrain; do not infer a reading error from the holdout residual.

Retain the clear 40.9 ft Cassland Road dot. The figure is printed on the park side, but its survey dot is in the roadway to the east. Preserve this position and local road profile when reconciling the park margin and railway cutting.

coverageReviews.finding: Inspected full context. The first is almost blank marsh without interior height dots; the second has river-edge heights; the third is chiefly Templemills Sidings. These do not supply new interior marsh controls around the isolated Waterworks River point. Keep that gap explicit; do not use railway or bank levels as marsh.

New adjoining source strip: northern filtering beds and banks kept separate, two additional interior marsh dots continue the nearly straight traverse, and six clear street dots constrain developed ground west of the canal. No off-traverse marsh dots found in this strip.
